national_news.title: Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar Conferred on 106 Young Artists
bullets: Union Minister for Culture and Tourism Gajendra Singh Shekhawat conferred the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar for 2024 and 2025 upon 106 young artists in New Delhi.
Presented by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, the award recognizes outstanding talent among young practitioners in the field of performing arts.
Notable awardees include Manisha Srivastava (Bihar) for Folk Music, Akram Khan Behrupiya (Rajasthan) for Folk Dance, Hito Kiho (Nagaland) for Choir Music, and Subhashree Swain for Chhau Dance.

national_news.title: Asian Para Games 2026 Opens in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
bullets: The Asian Para Games 2026 opened in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, featuring a 281-member Indian delegation comprising 168 athletes competing across 11 disciplines.
Para-badminton champion Pramod Bhagat and Paralympic sprinter Simran Sharma served as the flag-bearers for India at the opening ceremony held at Paloma Mizuho Stadium.
The Indian contingent wore deep blue blazers adorned with golden motifs inspired by the Indus Valley Civilisation, including the Priest-King sculpture, Dancing Girl figurine, and ancient seals.

national_news.title: Charles Matata Breaks Course Record at Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon
bullets: Kenya’s Charles Matata won the men’s elite race at the Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon, breaking the course record with a time of 58 minutes and 52 seconds over the 21.097-km course.
Ethiopia’s Wudinesh Alemu claimed the women’s elite title finishing in 1 hour, 6 minutes, and 35 seconds.
In the Indian elite category, Shailesh Kushwaha won the men’s race in 1:05:05, while Ankita Dhyani secured the women’s title in 1:12:46.
